# CLI baseline provenance

These 11 files are historical CLI characterization evidence moved from
`scripts/phase-1-baseline/` without changing their bytes. Their SHA-256 hashes
and byte counts are recorded in
`docs/plans/issue-100-test-migration-presentation.inventory.json`.

The baselines were captured in a controlled Linux environment. Historical
path-normalization substitutions are part of that evidence. They do not
establish interactive or rollback parity, and they are not active raw-byte
parity gates after the native behavioral-test migration.
